references.text: The Lord sanctifies the priest; the same expression 'I am the Lord who sanctifies' is used regarding the holiness and separation of the priests.
Repeats the theme of not profaning what is holy, and confirms that the Lord sanctifies the sanctuary and the priests.
Warns the priests against profaning the holy things, referencing that the Lord is the one who sanctifies them.
The Lord declares Himself as the one who sanctifies Israel, based on the same theological foundation for holiness.
The Lord is the one who sanctifies the people; a parallel formulation concerning God's sanctifying power.
Ezekiel repeats the rules regarding the priests' marriages to preserve holy offspring, following the same principle of not profaning their lineage.
Shows the consequence of impure descent: priests were excluded from priestly service because they could not prove their genealogy.
